summary: A button that opens into a field where it sits, the button riding along as its submit. Escape, or leaving it empty, closes it again.

props.name: label
props.description: What the button says, and the submit inside the open field.

props.name: icon
props.description: A glyph before the label on the closed button.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: The field's placeholder once it opens.

props.name: type
props.description: The kind of value, so the keyboard and the browser's checks fit it.

props.name: onSubmit
props.description: Called with the value on submit. While a promise it returns is pending the submit waits; once it settles the done line shows.

props.name: doneLabel
props.description: What shows for a moment after a submit, before the button returns.

props.name: size
props.description: Height of the button and the field.

props.name: animated
props.description: The width easing between the button and the field. Turn it off for an instant change; reduced motion does the same.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes. `merge` folds them in last, so one here replaces the component's own class for the same utility.

props.name: focus
props.description: The focus outline. `true` draws it, `false` removes it, and a string of Yumma CSS utilities restyles it. Removing it outright and putting nothing back fails WCAG 2.4.7.
